highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking for a leading public polytechnic with strong industry ties and a dynamic, hands‑on campus culture? Humber Polytechnic might be your ideal match. Humber offers a blend of deep theoretical learning and practical, career‑ready training.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At Humber, you’ll be part of a friendly student community. You’ll be in an interactive environment, with small class sizes, simulation labs, and work‑integrated learning. Whether you’re into tech, theatre, politics, or just want to meet people with similar interests, there’s a community for you.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Humber offers on‑campus housing for over 1,700 students. You can choose from three types of room styles: traditional single rooms, suite-style rooms, and semi-suite-style rooms.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Laboratory
You’ll find many labs and learning spaces, including specialised facilities for fitness, mixology, and sustainable technologies. These labs are designed to provide you with hands-on, practical experience in their respective fields.

Cafeteria
With several cafes and eateries on campus, you’ll find everything from grab-and-go options to sit-down meals. These include the Residence Dining Hall, Street Cafe, and several eateries.
